title: Bloated Walker
intro: A (zombieMoe) is a common type of Zombie encountered nearly everywhere. As of Alpha 20, they have the same stats as most other zombies, no longer having bonus health or higher attack power. In general, s are slower than the average zombie on the same speed setting. They can appear as feral or radiated versions, giving them even more health. At nighttime, the feral version can spawn as a nighttime feral.
location: Everywhere

title: Burn Victim
intro: A (zombieBurnt) is a special type of zombie that is only encountered in the Burnt Forest-biome and also rarely on Blood Moon hordes. Like the Frozen Lumberjack, these zombies were affected heavily by the biome around them, as Burn Victims resemble burning, charred wood. They typically stray around the roads or abandoned shacks you may find in the Burnt Forest and blend in with their surroundings, so keep alert for movement when travelling through their territory. When they are nearby they will emit hoarse moans and a constant 'crackling' akin to lit torches or campfires. Because of this, a pla
location: Burnt Forest-biome, Wasteland cities and buildings that contain fire in some way

title: Businessman
intro: Businessman Zombie is one of the different variants of Zombies. Usually, they can be randomly found throughout all biomes, but they can appear in large quantities in office parts of POIs. The Businessman Zombie appears to be a decomposing Asian man wearing a business outfit that is slightly torn and covered in blood.
location: Everywhere, predominantly in office areas inside buildings

title: Crawler Zombie
intro: The is a type of Zombie. It is considerably slower than the average zombie as it does not walk or run and instead drags itself along the ground. Its legs are missing, likely either from a fall, encounter with the infected/survivors or decay (likely worn away by dragging itself). The remains of its torso show late stages of rot, to the point where its spine and pelvis are visible, indicating this zombie to have be alive for a long time. What's left of its lower torso are the tendins of its intestines. This may be used to player's advantages as it's speed is independent of the speed settings. On
location: Everywhere, More common in the Burnt Forest-biome

title: Demolisher
intro: The Demolisher Zombie is a heavily armored military zombie. It appears in late-game Blood Moon hordes and rarely in downtown areas of Cities in Snowy Forest, Desert, or Wasteland. They don't spawn in Forest cities. Wasteland cities have more frequent spawns compared to other biomes. The Demolisher Zombie is easily recognizable by its large size and the green explosive charge on its chest. It excels in stomping spikes and exploding, causing massive damage to blocks and entities. The Demolisher zombie deals 20 damage to entities and 500 damage to blocks. If it explodes, the explosion deals up to
location: Blood Moon hordes and Cities

title: Departed Woman
intro: , previously "Zombie Marlene", is one of the variants of Zombies. These zombies died and turned long ago, evidence of this being the fact that their bodies are highly decomposed. The right side of her face is missing skin, revealing the skull, and her right eye is dangling out of what remains of the socket, barely attached by a few optical nerves.
location: Everywhere

title: Dire Wolf
intro: The is an uncommon zombie animal found in all biomes, but most often seen in the Wasteland. Dire Wolves are hostile and will try to chase and attack the player if provoked or if they spot the player. Dire Wolves are incredibly dangerous enemies and it is best to only fight them from range. They are fast with a large amount of HP and deal massive damage with high critical chance (currently one of the most dangerous zombies in the whole game). Keep your distance at all costs!!
location: All biomes
drops: Rotting Flesh Leather Animal Fat Bone

title: Fallen Soldier Zombie
intro: A soldier lost to the zombies, as seen by him walking around amongst them. His vest was ripped in half, and his torso was opened. His intestines are found dangling alongside the ripped open vest. He is commonly found in Army Camps or Army Barracks, as well as in 7-Day/Blood Moon hordes. Fallen Soldiers are more difficult to kill with headshots due to their helmet. They are considered armored and take 50% less damage from normal attacks. Armor piercing ammo is recommended. Due to this, they can be tougher than tough zombies such as Bloated Walkers and Hungry Zombies despite having less health t
location: Military and Government Installations, Roaming Military Hordes and "boss rooms" of larger POIs

title: Fat Hawaiian
intro: A Fat Hawaiian (Also known as a Disturbed Tourist) is a common type of Zombie that can be encountered anywhere and will be one of the toughest zombies that can appear from the start of a new game. They are larger than the average zombie, resulting in a higher damage resistance and greater damage output. Fat Hawaiians are slower than the average zombie and also run slightly slower than other zombies at night. Though this zombie makes the same sounds as the Infected Police Officer as well as the Mutant Zombie, the only unique feature of this zombie is that its health stands at 300. They are very
location: Everywhere

title: Festering Cadaver
intro: A (Zombie Joe) is one of the different variants of Zombies. These zombies appear as a young man wearing a short-sleeve jacket and t-shirt, plus shorts and dirty shoes. Like most zombies, they appear heavily decayed, and blood is smeared all across their faces and clothes.
location: Everywhere

title: Frozen Lumberjack
intro: The is one of the many different variants of Zombies. It is currently only found in Snowy Forest biome. Frozen Lumberjacks are very tall, with broad shoulders and thick beards, wear knitted caps with red flannel shirts and blue jeans, and are fairly easy to spot in the white snow even from great distances. Like all Zombies, their clothes are torn, dirty, and bloodstained. The Frozen Lumberjack will emit high-pitched wails when near a player, as well as a constant 'crunching' sound as it moves. This is likely to emphasize the fact it is literally a frozen, shambling corpse. It appears to be the
location: Snowy Forest-biome

title: Grace
intro: Grace is a giant green mutated boar found under 'Bob's Boars' and other various POIs. In 'Bob's Boars' particularly, Grace is found in a cave concealed under its cage in the backyard, with its name printed on it. The very same farm also contains samples of Super Corn, therefore it is a possibility that Grace is mutated due to its consumption of the mutated plant. Grace has a decent health pool, comparable to a radiated Zombie. Interestingly, harvesting Grace yields larger amounts of fat, Rotting flesh, leather, and more Bones than the normal animal counterpart, suggesting Grace may not even be
location: Carl's corn and Bob's boars POI
drops: Animal Fat Leather Rotting Flesh Bone

title: Hazmat Male Zombie
intro: A Hazmat Zombie is a semi-rare zombie found in Blood Moon Hordes, Military establishments, and scientific buildings like the Hospital. The old model was a re-used model of the Feral Wight. Despite having Hazmat gear on, they are not considered armored and still take full damage from normal weapons. Consider this before using Armor Piercing ammo on them.
location: Military and Government installations, Roaming Military Hordes and rarely in other places

location: Everywhere

title: Infected Mother
intro: , formerly "Zombie Darlene", is one of the variants of Zombies. These zombies died and turned long ago, evidence of this being the fact that their bodies are highly decomposed.

title: Infected Police Officer
intro: An is a special type of Zombie typically found in cities, suburbs, and wastelands, in addition to practically any POI at later gamestages. The ones found in Police Stations don't seem to respawn. They are known for having very high health, and their ability to destroy blocks with their acidic vomit. An Infected Police Officer is fairly easy to spot, as they are grotesquely disproportionate and wear a signature police uniform. They are incredibly bloated, and move very slow as a result, but the range of their acid can reach large distances. Infected Police Officers are also noted for making dis
location: Wasteland-biome, Blood Moon hordes and Police Stations, any POI at higher gamestages

title: Infected Survivor
intro: is one of the variants of Zombies. Probably just a normal citizen who got infected by the unknown virus and turned into a zombie.
location: Everywhere

title: Lab Zombie
intro: The can be found in laboratory settings and in Hospitals. They can also be found in Military facilities. Lab Zombies can be identified by their blood-splattered lab coat and ripped apart mouth and cheeks. Lab Zombies also carry a blue and white ID card on the left side of their coat. Their left hand appears to be broken as it sways lifelessly as the zombie walks.
location: Laboratory areas, also medical departments within Military installations

title: Mutated Zombie
intro: The is a zombie added in Alpha 20. It acts similarly to the Infected Police Officer, but it shoots its acid up and around itself. The acid does a base of 50 damage to blocks compared to the Infected Police Officer's 240 block damage spit attack. unlike the feral/radiated cop his special attack doesn't do extra damage to the player or blocks only his main attack damage increases It occasionally spawns in the Wasteland, as well as trapped in a certain Point of Interest laboratory. Despite the Mutated Zombie’s acid attack ability and it’s ability to irradiate the player briefly, the acid attack i
location: Wasteland

title: Party Girl
intro: is a variant of Zombies and was formerly known as Zombie Stripper and was changed in Alpha 20. These zombies died and turned long ago, evident from their highly decomposed bodies. Despite this, they continue to roam in search of humans to attack. The Zombie Stripper appears wearing a revealing, slightly torn dark dress, high heels, and ruined makeup, reflecting its past occupation. can commonly be found in Points of Interest like the The Boobie Trap and Bigg Buns. It was one of the first zombies to have "jiggle tech" added, which provides jiggle physics to parts of its body.
location: Everywhere

title: Plagued Nurse
intro: A is a type of Zombie encountered nearly everywhere. In the past the nurse was blood-covered and pale, green skin color and dark hair in what looked like to be a Halloween sexy Nurse outfit but now resembles an actual medical Nurse in scrubs. When nearby a player they will emit high-pitched, hoarse groans. They are slower than the average zombie, and typically easy to avoid and kill.
location: Everywhere, mostly in medical facilities

title: Putrid Girl
intro: These Zombies are normal zombies with not a whole lot of HP or strength, but like all zombies they can stun you and cause trouble in groups. The Putrid Girl can spawn anywhere and is usually found in Day 7 hordes. During night, the running behaviour is the same as all other zombies. If distance or sheer zombie numbers aren't a concern, scoring a headshot when it's running headfirst towards you can be slightly easier.
location: Everywhere, mostly in old western POIs

title: Reanimated Corpse
intro: A Reanimated Corpse (Zombie Steve) is one of the different variants of Zombies. This zombie is the corpse of an unknown person who died sometime during the beginning of the apocalypse and got reanimated as a zombie. It's also on the back of the game casing.
location: Everywhere

title: Rotting Carcass
intro: , formerly Zombie Yo, is one of the variants of Zombies. These zombies died and turned long ago, evidence of this being the fact that their bodies are highly decomposed. The massive head trauma might have been the cause of death and it is a good visual characteristic that helps identifying this zombie.
location: Everywhere

title: Screamer
intro: The is a special type of zombie that appears and investigates sources of player activity, referred to as heat levels that is based off of sound the player creates either by explosions, firing weapons, or mining using either a tool or an Auger. A can be easily identified by their signature white dress, long black hair, and high-pitched shrieks and hisses. They are also shorter than average zombies, and can occasionally be difficult to spot when behind cover. However, should the player be well-equipped, they can bait or trap a Screamer and kill the incoming hordes for XP. When they are done, sim
location: Spawns in the vicinity of the player once heat threshold has been reached

title: Skater Punk Zombie
intro: is a type of Normal Zombie. The wears a green-colored Hooded Sweatshirts and black-colored Denim Pants.
location: Everywhere

title: Spider Zombie
intro: The is a special type of Zombie encountered in Military bases, cities and during night hordes. They are distinguished by their signature crawling pattern, and various loud shrieks. The will typically announce its presence with continuous loud shrieking and various clicking noises and hisses. Typically a player will easily hear them long before they are actually spotted.
location: Everywhere, higher spawn rate outside at nighttime

title: Utility Worker Zombie
intro: is one of the different variants of Zombies. These zombies died and turned long ago, evidence of this being the fact that their bodies are highly decomposed. Although they're still walking in search of humans to kill.
location: Everywhere, predominantly construction sites in large groups

title: Wight
intro: The is a special type of zombie encountered in the later 7 Day hordes as well as in army bases, caves and in wasteland cities. These zombies are always feral. Unlike most zombies, s are not affected by daylight and can run after players at any time. They are also taller and much stronger than most zombies, making them very difficult and dangerous targets. Due to their strength, they pose a great threat to player built structures, and will tear down a wall with great speed. Players in Wasteland Towns should arm themselves amply, lest a threaten their base.
location: Wasteland-biome, Blood Moon hordes, Military and Government Installations, any POI at higher gamestage

title: Zombie Bear

They are hostile and will chase and attempt to attack the player on sight or if provoked. It will also attack other Animals and Zombies, usually emerging victorious, as the Zombie Bear is one of the most dangerous enemies you can encounter in Navezgane. Since they are able to one-shot a player at full health, it is best to use ranged weapons and avoid any sort of melee combat with the bear without utilising strong armour and healing items. location: Wasteland-biome, Burnt Forest-biome, and some particular POIs

title: Zombie Biker
intro: is one of the different variants of Zombies. These zombies died and turned long ago, evidence of this being the fact that their bodies are highly decomposed. Although they're still walking in search of humans to kill. They are wearing a helmet, which may make headshots less effective. They are considered armored due to their helmet and tough leather clothing, taking 20% less damage from most attacks. Armor piercing ammo is recommended.

Having appearance of a Doberman Pinscher, s are much faster than players and will easily outrun a player and catch them, so it is advised to take them down as fast as you can before they can reach you, or get to high ground like a car as they cannot climb it. s are one of the few zombie enemies that can run during the day. s can

title: Zombie Janitor
intro: is a normal zombie present in the world of Navezgane. It has a feral and a radiated version that has higher damage and health. They are wearing a bloody and filthy boiler suit and blood-covered boots. Their hair also appears to be receding.

title: Zombie Tom Clark
intro: The is a special type of Zombie encountered everywhere. This newer model of Tom Clark is a replacement from previous. The Fun Pimps decided to make this new model with normal characteristics and is like any other Zombie and no longer crawls around as a Spider Zombie as it was prior to Alpha 19.6.
